basic_info.description: This is a magical and charming Victorian single family home in Dolores Heights with beautiful period details and smart updates. Bright, open floor plan on the main level with skylit entry, built-in seating and the large primary suite with double closets, built-ins galore and tile/marble bath. The kitchen comes complete with a Bertazzoni 5-burner gas range, Liebherr fridge, Bosch dishwasher, wide sink and center island with seating as it flows into dining/living areas. Huge sliding glass doors bring in lots of light and open to the large deck affording southern views and gorgeous cork tree. There is also a guest half bath on the main level. Downstairs: 2 large bedrooms, each with garden access, as well as a full bath, laundry room and workshop. Wonderful foliage covered backyard perfect for chill/outdoor dining, and the faint, romantic sound of the trolly as it trundles nearby. Two blocks to the Valencia Corridor, the award-winning Dolores Park, and one block to J Church line. City living with side-street charm, modern comfort and historic character in one perfect home.
